offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures avionics for aircraft manufacturers, fleet operators and military customers. It supplies systems for new aircraft and retrofits and provides avionics repair and overhaul.

primary_products.value: Cockpit displays; air data systems; flight computers and autothrottles; inertial navigation systems; aircraft communications radios

primary_services.value: Avionics repair and overhaul; retrofit engineering and integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Aircraft manufacturers, commercial and business aircraft operators, defense contractors and maintenance shops; B2G: Military aviation agencies

end_markets.value: Commercial aviation; business and general aviation; military aviation

revenue_model.value: product sales: Avionics equipment for new aircraft and retrofit kits for existing fleets; service fees: Repair and overhaul of installed avionics

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds avionics from electronic components and embedded software for aircraft manufacturers and fleet operators; service provider: Repairs and overhauls avionics for aircraft operators and maintenance organizations

geography_served.value: global: United States and international aviation markets

specialization.value: related lines: Cockpit instrumentation, flight controls, navigation and communications equipment, and aftermarket avionics services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Aircraft manufacturers, fleet operators and military procurement programs; partners / resellers: Avionics installers and maintenance centers that supply retrofit systems

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FAA airworthiness approvals for avionics and installations, and FAA certification requirements for repair stations

notes: The relative scale of its current avionics product lines is uncertain.
